reviews.text: Friendly staff, pleasant environment. Doctors and nurses are very helpful, they help with everything. You may have to wait for a long time.

After my cat underwent dental surgery at this clinic, she stopped eating completely and her condition quickly worsened. We contacted the clinic repeatedly, but were told it was “just stress after the procedure.” Despite the fact that she had not eaten for six days and was clearly in serious distress, no proper diagnostics were performed. She was only given pain relief, appetite stimulant injections, and vitamins.

I truly trusted this clinic and followed their advice, which is why I did not immediately seek help elsewhere. I kept believing their explanation instead of taking her to another clinic sooner.

As her condition continued to deteriorate, we finally went to a different veterinary clinic. There, they immediately took blood tests and properly assessed her condition. They discovered a severe decline in kidney function. Intensive treatment was started right away, but unfortunately, it was too late.

My cat passed away.

I cannot recommend this clinic. In my experience, there was a serious lack of attention to her condition and a failure to act when clear warning signs were present. Even after six days without eating, basic diagnostics like bloodwork were not done, and her condition was repeatedly dismissed as stress.

This is written as a warning to other pet owners: if your animal is not recovering after a procedure, insist on proper testing or seek a second opinion immediately. I would not want anyone else to go through this kind of loss due to negligence.
They are also helpful over the phone. I called them because I suspected I had a concussion, they told me what symptoms to look out for and when to go for an examination.

I’ve been there with many kinds old animal 😂 All the experience were awesome ❤️ as a English speaking service client we love Dr.Lola, she is always taking the good amount of  time to provide  information, I am really happy to have a good doctor like her for my biscuit ❤️ …

I've been coming here with our animals since the clinic opened. Among other things, because it was open on weekends, which is a rare thing!!! The new opening hours are absurd! There are definitely fewer patients now because these times are absolutely not suitable for working clients.. I wouldn't be surprised if it ends up closing..

The opening hours could be better.... The fact that you are only open two days a week until 7:00 PM is pretty steep... And you are open three days until 3:00 PM... Well, we have work, jobs, we can't be there before closing. This is not fair. My cat has been sick since Friday, and I have to wait until Tuesday to take her to you. This is not fair. I can't take her anywhere else because there is no one else nearby. Change your opening hours, hire more vets...

They have saved my puppy's life at least four times so far. Thank you very much.
Toto and his owner.

Really good exp here with the doctor team and the reception. I will have a flight with my cat and they could provided the necessary paperwork, passport and vaccines which I found really convenient . The doctor also checked up generally and gave good advice for my cat !! Thank you so much!! And here I can drop in with out appointment so it is good too :)

It was our first time coming here because we needed a vaccination for our dog. Receptionist is very clever, she was answering kindly and politely to our questions. Many thanks to Dr. Lola, she helped us in our case. Professional, fast, clean. Recommend this clinic for sure!
The doctors are very nice and attentive.
No one has ever examined my cat so thoroughly and explained what to do so clearly. Thank you to the team and Dr. Balázs Szulyovszky for their help.

I love this place! I've taken my dog ​​there 3 times already. Before, every time I took him, they said he had to be put to sleep because they couldn't hold him down, even though he's a small bichon. Here, they were kind to Casper right away and were able to calm him down. I wholeheartedly recommend this clinic to everyone!!

I would like to thank the entire medical team, our puppy and we are grateful that they did not let him suffer. We had to let him go because he became very sick in a very short time. The most humane team, because here it is not about the money, but really about what they swore to do. We went to Dr. Gusztáv Font's office for 15 years, but the last time we met and talked to almost every doctor and everyone worked conscientiously to make sure that the best was for everyone. In other words, Buksi is now fine because he finally doesn't have any pain. Maybe it will get better for us in time.
I raise my hat to all the doctors there and thank you for everything.
My respectful greetings
Mrs. György Gyimesi

Fantastic team! Our cat received excellent care! Thank you to Dr. Sulyovszky for his thoroughness and helpfulness, for patiently explaining everything to us if something was unclear, and even for explaining it all to my partner in English. The receptionist and the assistant ladies are also super nice and helpful. I highly recommend this place!!

If human healthcare was like the service sick animals receive here, we would be the best healthcare in the world. I am very grateful to all the employees of Cityvet for the immeasurable love and attention they feel and provide for sick animals. The best place!

We have been going to this clinic for over 10 years.
We went to Dr. Font for a very long time, then to Dr. Szulyovky.
Great doctors! I recommend them to everyone with all my heart!
And last but not least, the assistants, the two ladies working at the reception are also phenomenal!
We love the whole team!
They are always very kind, they treat my old cat professionally and with a lot of calmness and patience.
The lady in the reception is so kind and friendly, and the doctor and his assistant were super clear, friendly and professional with our cat! 🐱 …
Everyone was very kind to us. I can only recommend them!

I have known veterinarians Dr. Gusztáv Font and Dr. Balázs Szulyovszky since the beginning of their careers. It is incredible what they have done for our animals. My first dog lived for 10 years, my second dog for 19 years, my cat for 19 years, our bunny lived to the age of Methuselah under their care. During this time, there were tumors, kidney disease, abscesses, cherry eye, medical-tail amputation and the removal of the eye of our recently shot cat. I can only bow before the professionalism, empathy and conscientiousness of our doctors. As long as I live, I will be grateful that they have cured our animals and are currently curing them. Thank you for everything, everything!!!

You saved my dog's life!
Thank you!

All the staff and the vets are so nice ! They are efficient, very available and they take the time to answer all your questions. They are also fluent in English so I would definitely recommend this place to foreigners!
Amazing service from the receptionist to nurses and doctors very helpful and they speak English
Everyone was very kind. Both to the cats and to me. I got a lot of useful advice. We will be back.
Nicest vets ❤️
We only bring our puppies here, with kind nurses and precise, excellent doctors!

Dr. Lola and Dr. Balazs helped to my cat from 1st day despite of their tight schedule. They made a successful surgery, regular follow-ups, and clear communication throughout the process. I am very grateful to find this team where all staff speaks English.

Long wait, sometimes over an hour. No matter that you booked, no matter that you are with an old and scared animal.
It is a long overdue review after the grief of the sudden loss of my 9 years old dog due to renal failure.
My opinion is that Dr. Szabó Lola has zero competence in kidney disease in dogs and the mistreatment and her lack of expertise greatly contributed to the premature dead of my dog. I studied a lot in the subject after the shock, so I know exactly what I'm talking about.
My dog's condition exponentially worsened when Dr. Szabó Lola  started to give toxic injections to help my dog's appetite and to stop vomiting. These injections only put more strain on the kidneys. Whereas a special diet should have been applied and no chemicals.
The worse of all she later asked if my dog "otthon pusztult el?" -which is a disgusting way to talk about the passing of a loved one, a family member and extremely disrespectful.
Kedves Lola ha ezt olvassa az ön családtagjai elpusztulnak? Döbbenet, hogy legalább tudna tapintattal kommunikálni ha a szakmájához nem ért!!!

On the recommendation of my girlfriend, we have been coming here with my cat for over 5 years. The team is very professional. My cat has had 3 surgeries including the current one. They called me after all the surgeries to see how it went. I feel like my pets are in good hands here. A veterinary clinic like this is a great asset to me and the owners of the entire city.
